tutorial.trickDisplay: This is the current trick. You must follow the led suit. There is no trump. Rank runs 3>2>A>K>Q>J>7>6>5>4. Points: A=1, 2/3/J/Q/K=1/3 each, others 0, plus +1/3 for the last trick — 33 thirds (11 points) per deal.

tutorial.info: Calabresella (Terziglio) is a Calabrian/Italian 3-player 40-card trick-taker. First a Bid phase (pass / chiamo / solo) decides the Soloist, who takes the 4-card monte and discards four cards down to twelve. There is no trump; you must follow the led suit. The Soloist wins the round by capturing more than half of the 33 thirds (18+). Stakes are transferred and the first player to reach the target (default 21) wins.
